question: Where do I find the Online Scheduler settings?
answer:
Go to **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**.

The settings page has these sections (top to bottom, left-to-right layout):

**Left column**
- Turn On/Off Opcodes for Online Scheduler (toggle + Edit Opcode Format link)
- Appointment Slot Size (radio buttons)
- Online scheduler call routing (phone number input)
- Default Next Appointment Settings (time in weeks + mileage in miles)
- Custom Header Message (rich-text editor with Preview / Reset to Default)

**Right column**
- Brands available to schedule (multi-select dropdown)
- Restriction of Online Appointment Scheduling (minimum hours ahead dropdown)
- Custom Background Image Upload (with Preview / Reset to Default)
- Price Expiration Duration For Previously Declined Services (months + days dropdowns, conditional on the feature being enabled)

Each section saves via the **SAVE CHANGES** button at the top or bottom of the page. Access requires the General Settings authority (typically held by service managers).

question: How do I let customers choose services (opcodes) on the online scheduler?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, find the **Turn On/Off Opcodes for Online Scheduler** toggle at the top of the left column.

- **On** → customers see your configured services and can pick one during booking
- **Off** → no service selection — customers just pick a time

When the toggle is on, click **Edit Opcode Format** right next to it to control which fields display on each service (see "How do I show or hide service prices / descriptions / custom text?").

Which opcodes actually appear online is controlled per-opcode in **Settings → Appointments → Opcodes And Dealer Menus** → edit the opcode → enable **Online Scheduler** under the Product × Eligibility section.

Click **SAVE CHANGES** after adjustments.

question: How do I show or hide service prices, descriptions, or custom text on the online scheduler?
answer:
Go to **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, then click the **Edit Opcode Format** link (just below the Turn On/Off Opcodes toggle).

The Edit Visibility Options popup lets you independently toggle:
- **Name** — service name
- **Description** — service description
- **Price** — the dollar amount
- **Custom Text** — a short label shown with the price (max 20 chars, default *Price starts at:*)

Common setups:
- Display *Price may vary* instead of *Price starts at:* → enable Custom Text, change text to `Price may vary`
- Hide prices entirely → disable the Price toggle

Save the popup, then click **SAVE CHANGES** on the main screen.

question: How do I show "Price may vary" on the online scheduler instead of a firm price?
answer:
The "Price may vary" label is the **Custom Text** field in the opcode format settings:

1. Go to **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**
2. Click **Edit Opcode Format** (under Turn On/Off Opcodes)
3. Enable **Custom Text**
4. Enter `Price may vary` (up to 20 characters)
5. Optionally disable the **Price** toggle if you don't want a dollar amount shown at all
6. Save the popup → click **SAVE CHANGES** on the main screen

The label will appear next to each service in the online scheduler in place of (or alongside) the price.

question: How do I change the appointment slot size on the online scheduler?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, the **Appointment Slot Size** section has radio buttons for **5, 10, 15, 20, 30, and 60 minutes**.

The description says: *This setting lets you choose the appointment time intervals for which your dealership will allow appointments to be set.*

**Important:** The radios are often disabled with this message: *This feature is currently not available. Please call myKaarma support team (562-349-1367) to get assistance.*

If disabled, **contact myKaarma support** — slot size is a sensitive primitive that affects existing appointments, so myK changes it manually. The change takes up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

question: How do I set the "Call Me Now" phone number on the online scheduler?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, the **Online scheduler call routing** section has a phone number input.

The hint says: *Put the number below that is best for your customers to call when scheduling appointments. This number will be called when a customer select 'call me now' when scheduling an appointment on your website.*

1. Enter the phone number you want the button to dial (10-digit US format, e.g., `5551234567`)
2. Click **SAVE CHANGES**

If this section is hidden on your Online Scheduler page, voice calls are disabled for your dealership — contact myKaarma support to enable them.

question: How do I choose which brands are available to schedule online?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler** (right column), use the **Brands available to schedule** dropdown.

The hint reads: *Select the brands below that will be displayed as options when your customers and appointment setting personnel are creating appointments in the scheduler.*

1. Open the **Brands** dropdown — it lists every make associated with your dealer
2. Check each brand you want shown
3. Uncheck brands you don't want
4. Click **SAVE CHANGES**

Customers only see the brands you've checked when picking their vehicle during online booking.

question: How do I set the minimum advance notice for online bookings?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler** (right column), the section is called **Restriction of Online Appointment Scheduling**.

The hint says: *Select the required minimum number of hours ahead that a customer is allowed to book an appointment online. For example, if it is 9 a.m. and '24 hours' is selected here, then the customer will only be able to book appointments for 9 a.m. tomorrow or thereafter.*

The dropdown offers values from 0 to 72 hours. Common picks:
- **0 hour** — customers can book same-day up to right now
- **2 hours** — prevents "I need service in 30 minutes" bookings
- **24 hours** — requires a full day of notice

Click **SAVE CHANGES**. The new rule applies immediately for future bookings.

question: How do I add a custom message at the top of the online scheduler?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, the **Custom Header Message** section has a rich-text editor (with Source / Styles / Format options).

Help text: *Describe the message that you like to convey to your clients scheduling appointments online. This message can be any promotional message or any general comments that you like them to know.*

1. Type or paste your message — formatting, lists, and links are supported
2. Click **PREVIEW** to see how it looks to customers
3. Click **SAVE CHANGES** at the top of the page to commit
4. Use **RESET TO DEFAULT** to wipe the custom message back to the default

Common uses: seasonal promotions, important notices (holiday closures), arrival instructions.

question: How do I upload a custom background image for the online scheduler?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler** (right column), the **Custom Background Image Upload** section.

Help text: *This image will be displayed in the background for online scheduler. For assistance, please contact support@mykaarma.com.*

1. Click the upload area (or **Replace** if an image is already set)
2. Pick an image from your computer (JPG / PNG / WebP recommended, under a few MB)
3. The image uploads to AWS and a preview appears
4. Click **SAVE CHANGES** on the main screen

- Click **PREVIEW** to see it live on the scheduler
- Click **RESET TO DEFAULT** to remove the custom image and fall back to the default background

Use a subtle, high-resolution image that doesn't compete visually with the scheduler UI — dealership exterior or landscape photos usually work well.

question: How do I preview my online scheduler changes before customers see them?
answer:
Two built-in preview options are in **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**:

- **PREVIEW** button next to **Custom Header Message** — opens a popup showing how your header message will appear
- **PREVIEW** button next to **Custom Background Image** — shows the background image live

For a full end-to-end view, open your public online scheduler URL in an incognito browser window — that way your admin session doesn't interfere.

Changes you haven't saved are only visible in the built-in Preview popup. For a full live preview, click **SAVE CHANGES** first, then refresh the public URL.

question: How do I set the default time and mileage for the next service appointment?
answer:
In **Settings → Appointments → Online Scheduler**, the **Default Next Appointment Settings** section has:

- **Default time until the next Appointment:** in *weeks*
- **Default mileage until the next Appointment:** in *miles*

Enter your preferred defaults and click **SAVE CHANGES**.

These defaults power the "next service due" date / mileage on invoices and reminders. They are defaults — individual opcodes can override them at the opcode level (Settings → Appointments → Opcodes And Dealer Menus).

Typical setups: 12 weeks / 5000 mi for standard oil changes; 26 weeks / 10000 mi for a longer service cadence.

question: How do I control how long previously declined service prices stay valid?
answer:
If your dealer has the "Previously Declined Services" integration enabled, the **Price Expiration Duration For Previously Declined Services** section appears in the right column of Online Scheduler settings.

Help text: *Set the duration in form of month and days after which prices for declined services will expire.*

- **Months** dropdown (0 – 12 months)
- **Days** dropdown (0 – 30 days)

After a service is declined by the customer, its quoted price continues to display on future scheduler visits until that duration expires, after which the price resets (customer sees no price and typically gets re-quoted).

Common setting: 3 months. Keeps returning-customer pricing consistent without letting outdated prices linger.

If you don't see this section, the declined-services feature isn't enabled for your dealer — contact myKaarma support.

question: Why is the online scheduler showing no availability?
answer:
Work through these in order:

1. **Dealer schedule closed** — check **Settings → Appointments → Dealer Schedule**. A closed day shows no slots.
2. **No individual advisors scheduled** — **Settings → Appointments → Individuals Schedule**. Without advisors, there's no capacity.
3. **A capacity rule is blocking** — **Settings → Appointments → Capacity Rules**. Look for a rule restricting that day / transport option / opcode. Disable or adjust it.
4. **Minimum advance notice** — in Online Scheduler settings, **Restriction of Online Appointment Scheduling**. If 72 hours is set, all slots in the next 3 days are hidden.
5. **Transport option not available online** — a customer who picks a transport option that is NOT marked **Available Online** will see no availability. Check **Settings → Appointments → Transport Options** → each option's Available Online toggle.
6. **Brand restriction** — if the customer's brand isn't in your **Brands available to schedule** list, they see nothing for that vehicle.
7. **Cache** — have the customer try a fresh incognito browser window.
8. **Online Reserve limit exhausted** — the Transport Option Availability Management section has a separate **Online Reserve** daily/weekly limit. If that's at 0 (or fully booked), online customers see no slots even though advisors can still book the Total capacity. See the transport options KB.

If none of the above explains it, contact myKaarma support with the specific date, brand, and transport option.
